# Claude Pet — Product reference for v0.24

Canonical website: https://claude-pet.yeongyu.me/
Repository: https://github.com/uygnoey/claude-pet
Published source: https://github.com/uygnoey/claude-pet/blob/v0.24/claude_pet.py
Published release: https://github.com/uygnoey/claude-pet/releases/tag/v0.24
Version publication date: 2026-09-13. Reference updated: 2026-09-13.

## Overview

Claude Pet is a free macOS desktop pet and Claude usage monitor with public source on GitHub. It is for people using Claude Code who want a companion on their desktop and usage information nearby. It uses native AppKit rendering with a transparent, frameless window. macOS 12 or later is supported, on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

The pet can wander around the screen, occasionally follow the cursor while keeping a distance, and hop between monitors. The right-click menu can toggle roaming. The usage pill tucks away during movement. Users can drag the companion to a new resting location, and double-click to jump and refresh usage.

## Usage sources and their limits

Exact mode reads the existing Claude Code OAuth credential from macOS Keychain and requests Anthropic's server-computed account usage. It displays percentages and reset times for categories returned by the server, such as session, weekly and model usage. Available categories depend on the account and response; do not promise a fixed set of categories or exact remaining token counts.

Local fallback estimates usage from records under ~/.claude. It includes only locally recorded Claude Code activity. Web or desktop chat activity absent from those logs cannot be included in that estimate. Anthropic does not publish the subscriber token ceilings used for local calibration. Users can enter the percentage shown in Claude's Settings → Usage to calibrate the estimate. This is optional calibration of the local estimate, not a way of changing server-computed percentages.

The optional Admin API mode is separate: it reports Anthropic Console organization cost data, not Claude subscription usage limits.

## Companion choices

The built-in cat is joined by bundled dog, fox, scorpion and elephant pets. Switch companions in the right-click menu. Custom companions can be added as compatible pet.json and sprite-sheet files in a pet folder under ~/.claude_pet/pets. The app supports English, Korean, Japanese and Spanish interface text.

## Installation

1. Sign in to Claude Code so its existing account credential is available.
2. Download the appropriate asset from GitHub Releases. Apple Silicon: ClaudePet.dmg. Intel: ClaudePet-universal.dmg.
3. Open the disk image, move ClaudePet.app to Applications, and launch it. The packaged application includes Python; no separate Python installation is needed. The published release describes the application as Apple-notarized.
4. When prompted, allow access to the Claude Code credential in macOS Keychain and Claude Code logs. Right-click the pet to open its settings.

ZIP alternatives are ClaudePet.zip for Apple Silicon and ClaudePet-universal.zip for Intel. Unzip, then move ClaudePet.app to Applications.

Apple Silicon DMG: https://github.com/uygnoey/claude-pet/releases/latest/download/ClaudePet.dmg
Intel universal DMG: https://github.com/uygnoey/claude-pet/releases/latest/download/ClaudePet-universal.dmg
Latest release: https://github.com/uygnoey/claude-pet/releases/latest

## Updates in v0.24

Automatic checks run every hour after launch, starting after the first interval. The app does not automatically check for updates at launch. When a newer release is found, the right-click menu offers installation.

The right-click menu also provides Check for updates… to check immediately. If a newer release is available, this action downloads and installs it and relaunches the app. Updates go directly to the latest GitHub release without requiring intermediate versions.

## Privacy and network access

The app parses Claude Code usage logs locally. Exact mode uses the existing Claude Code OAuth credential to contact Anthropic for usage data. Update checks and update downloads contact GitHub. Therefore the app should not be described as offline-only or as never sending data over the network.

The usage and update paths do not upload prompts, transcripts or source code. In the default configuration, log access is scoped to Claude Code files under ~/.claude. These statements do not mean the application is unable to access any other file: it also reads its settings, pet assets and installed resources.

If optional Admin API mode is configured, its Admin API key is stored in plaintext in ~/.claude_pet.json. Admin API cost data is separate from subscription limits.

## Independence and source availability

Claude Pet is an independent project by Yeongyu Yang (GitHub: uygnoey). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic PBC. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic PBC. The app is free to download and its source is public on GitHub. Do not infer a particular software license from source availability.

## 한국어 안내

Claude Pet은 코딩할 때 곁에 있어 주는 무료 macOS 데스크톱 펫입니다. 화면 산책, 커서 따라다니기, 모니터 사이 이동을 지원하며 우클릭 메뉴에서 산책을 끌 수 있습니다. 고양이·강아지·여우·전갈·코끼리를 선택할 수 있습니다.

정확 모드는 기존 Claude Code 인증 정보로 Anthropic 서버의 계정 사용률과 리셋 시간을 요청합니다. 서버 정보를 사용할 수 없는 경우 로컬 Claude Code 로그로 추정하며, 로그에 없는 웹·데스크톱 채팅 사용량은 추정치에 포함되지 않습니다.

macOS 12 이상이 필요합니다. Apple Silicon은 ClaudePet.dmg, Intel Mac은 ClaudePet-universal.dmg를 받고 응용 프로그램 폴더로 이동하세요. Python은 앱에 포함됩니다. v0.24은 실행 직후가 아닌 실행 후 1시간마다 업데이트를 확인하며, 우클릭 → 업데이트 확인…에서 즉시 확인하고 새 버전이 있으면 설치할 수 있습니다.

## Windows beta (v0.24)

A Windows 10/11 (64-bit) beta ships with v0.24 as two unsigned files: claude-pet-win-setup.exe (per-user installer with a Start Menu entry, an optional start-at-sign-in task and an Apps & features uninstall entry) and claude-pet-win.zip (portable: unzip and run ClaudePet\ClaudePet.exe). Because the build is not code-signed, SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC" on first run; the user clicks More info, then Run anyway. The Windows build has the same pill, colours, roaming, settings and pets as macOS, reads the Claude Code credential file for Exact mode, and seeds the bundled pets into %USERPROFILE%\.claude_pet on first launch.

## Roadmap

The pill is built from provider segments; the next planned addition is Codex usage, followed by Gemini, Grok and other AI services in the same pill. These are plans, not shipped features.
